child_briefs.title: Hunt Phase Worker
child_briefs.scope: Build ngv2/workers/hunt.py exposing `run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]` for the hunt phase. It composes the injected llm-client seam with the hunt-phase may_confirm gate to surface candidate findings, returning a list of artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and shaped for the contracts.Finding dataclass. Author a paired test_authoring sibling whose mutation_target is ngv2/workers/hunt.py, with a verification_command naming the authored oracle, exercising at least two edge cases (e.g. empty/no-lead llm-client response and a gate that rejects a candidate) driven entirely by a stub llm-client and stub seams.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not build the seam assembler (build_default_seams), the conductor loop, gated_advance, or the StageWorker base runner. Do not build triage.py, verify.py, or any late-phase worker (poc.py, detonate.py, novelty.py, report.py). Do not edit any existing committed module (llm_client.py, contracts.py, the gate modules, artifact_harvester.py, session_get_task.py, base_worker) in place.
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes get_task(session_row: dict) -> {phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package} from conductor_glue (ngv2/session_get_task.py). Consumes `StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn)` from base_worker. Reads (does not modify) the signatures of the seams it composes via injection: ngv2/llm_client.py (the injected model seam); the hunt-phase may_confirm gate module; ngv2/contracts.py dataclass Finding; ngv2/artifact_harvester.py parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) for the artifact dict shape.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/workers/hunt.py exposing `run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]` returning artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact and shaped for the contracts.Finding dataclass. Plus a test_authoring sibling with mutation_target = ngv2/workers/hunt.py and a verification_command naming the authored oracle.
